text: As a Senior Platform Engineer at AdvertiseX, I’ve spent seven years architecting and scaling mission-critical systems that power ad-tech innovation. My expertise lies in building resilient, high-performance platforms that balance complexity with simplicity—whether optimizing PostgreSQL for real-time campaign analytics, leveraging Python to automate infrastructure workflows, or harnessing Redis to cache ad-serving pipelines. I’ve led CI/CD transformations that slashed deployment times by 40%, ensuring zero-downtime updates for global ad campaigns. On AWS, I’ve mastered cloud cost optimization, slashing infrastructure spend by 25% through strategic resource allocation and auto-scaling, while mentoring teams to adopt Infrastructure as Code via Terraform. Kubernetes has been my go-to for orchestrating microservices, enabling seamless scaling during peak traffic spikes. Load balancers and monitoring stacks (Prometheus/Grafana) are my guardians of reliability, ensuring 99.99% uptime for ad delivery systems. I’ve also pioneered serverless architectures that cut operational overhead while boosting scalability. My work isn’t just about code—it’s about driving innovation that shapes the future of ad-tech. Let’s build smarter, faster, and more efficient platforms together.
